name: Rizuhble's Cat Got Your Tongue
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out before you can jump them. Sell it once you're out of slots.

items.name: Grit
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They burst you every time you slash in. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-11,200 (levels 1-18). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Gloom Bombs T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Spirit Snatch, vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Stalker
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Cold Front
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases
items.legacy_note: Slash, then pop it so they're slowed for the bombs.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Spirit Strike (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 11,200-26,400 (levels 18-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Return to Shadows T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Gloom Bombs, damage) grows from 81.5 to 118.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 6.4 to Gloom Bombs's damage (0.64x scaling).
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 8k spirit in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | +18 spirit adds about 11.6 to Gloom Bombs's damage (0.64x scaling).

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Gloom Bombs: takes 18% off its 11s base cooldown.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you. Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 14,400 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 149s; 20% off is 29.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 26,400-46,400 (levels 28-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Ava T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Gloom Bombs, damage) grows from 118 to 169.

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,800 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: +30 spirit adds about 19.3 to Gloom Bombs's damage (0.64x scaling).

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Cast it on yourself before you jump in.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you before you can get out.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts catch you as you come out of Ava.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Three or more of them have stuns or silences to throw at you.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Leaping Slash (movement) and Ava (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep stopping your slash and your ult.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Mystic Vulnerability for 4,800 more souls: tech resist 8 to 17..

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On Gloom Bombs. Sell Stalker for this.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Return to Shadows gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (95s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Replaces Lifestrike: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Replaces Spirit Snatch: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Replaces Dispel Magic: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
